title: Divergence: thermite-syntax parse_type rejects unit return `()` (surface-grammar.md decision 4 / REQ-8)

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Failing test at thermite-syntax/tests/divergence_grammar.rs::divergence_unit_return_type_accepted. Input `fn f(x: u32) -> () ...` yields Unexpected{expected:"a type",found:"`(`"}. Authority: surface-grammar.md decision 4 + RetType EBNF — `-> ()` is the explicit unit return spelling. parse_type in parser.rs has no () production.

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Fixed in 5bb910e: parse_type accepts () unit type (ast.rs Type::Unit + parser.rs LParen arm). divergence_unit_return_type_accepted now passes (un-ignored). Gauntlet green.
